text:
megan: hi folks 
I'm starting next Mon (yay!) and saw the handbook note about PTO accrual proration for new hires. two quick q's: 1) when does my accrual start exactly? first day or payroll period? 2) our team has a year-end freeze the last week of Dec - will I be blocked from booking a day even if I have prorated days?
mina: welcome, @megan! short answers: accrual begins on your first day and is prorated by pay period. longer: we calculate accrual from your start date to the next payroll cutoff, then apply prorated balance to your leave balance. you can see the projected amount in the portal under "Time off > Balances".
megan: thanks - so if I start mid-pay-period will i see anything immediately or only after payroll posts?
mina: you'll see a projected/estimated balance immediately. the official credited days post at payroll run; if you need a day before that, request unpaid or floating if eligible.
tom: manager note: team allows one-day exceptions during the year-end freeze for new hires' onboarding appointments. what's the formal process to request that?
mina: good question. process: submit a time-off request, choose "prorated PTO" in the dropdown, add "onboarding exception" in the notes, and CC your manager. people-ops will auto-route it to the freeze exceptions queue. approvals typically within 48 hours if coverage is minimal.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: blackout exception requests submitted less than 72 hours before the freeze start may not be processed in time. See https://hr.redwood.com/blackouts
megan: okay will do. one more - if i accrue 1.5 days in that first partial month and take 1 day during freeze, does that reduce the carryover eligibility for next year?
mina: prorated days are treated like any PTO earned that year. carryover rules still apply at year-end caps. so taking 1 of 1.5 reduces what can carry over. if you want to preserve carryover for time-off later, consider using a floating holiday first (if you have any).
megan: got it. submitting request now and tagging @tom. thanks for the clear steps!
people-ops-bot: Notification: request 2775554321-1 submitted and queued for manager approval.
tom: approved - coverage arranged. people-ops, please fast-track since start date is 3 days away.
mina: approved and fast-tracked. marked as "onboarding exception during year-end freeze". payroll will post prorated accrual on first run and adjust if needed. welcome aboard, @megan :)
megan: thanks everyone 60a
